metadata.name: Saboteur Class Tree
metadata.description: Trap and gadget focused class. Traps branch left, gadgets branch right, trunk center. Evasion woven throughout.

data.name: Fervour
data.description: Placing a trap or a gadget generates Fervour, and so does one of them dealing damage or triggering: 1 for each trap placed, 1 for each gadget placed, 1 each time a trap triggers and 1 for each blow one of them lands. It adds no rule about emptying, so your Fervour does not decay on its own.

data.name: Hair Trigger
data.description: +10% trap trigger radius per point. At 5 points: Traps arm instantly upon placement instead of after a 1 second delay.

data.name: Overkill
data.description: When Fervour is generated while already at maximum, gain a stack of Overkill granting +5% damage. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 2 seconds.

data.name: Calculated
data.description: +5 maximum Fervour per point. At 6 points: Your maximum Fervour is increased by 10%.

data.name: Slippery
data.description: +1% evasion chance per point. At 5 points: After successfully evading, gain 3 Fervour.

data.name: Light Footed
data.description: +5% of your current evasion chance per point while moving.

data.name: Bag of Tricks
data.description: Your traps reserve 4% reduced Fervour and your gadgets reserve 10% reduced Fervour, per point.

data.name: Volatile Mixture
data.description: +3% trap and explosive area of effect per point. At 5 points: Trap explosions leave a burning patch for 2 seconds dealing 10% of their damage per second.

data.name: Tinkerer
data.description: +3% gadget damage per point. At 6 points: Gadgets remain active 20% longer per point invested beyond 6.

data.name: On Your Toes
data.description: +2% damage per point for 3 seconds after successfully evading.

data.name: Prepared
data.description: +2% to all damage per point while above 50% of your maximum Fervour.

data.name: Trapsmith
data.description: +6% trap arming speed per point. At 4 points: Traps can be placed while moving without interrupting your movement.

data.name: Hair Wire
data.description: +10% trap trigger radius per point. At 4 points: Your traps arm 20% faster.

data.name: Volatile Casing
data.description: Each active trap on the battlefield reduces the arming delay of all your other traps by 0.1 seconds per point, to a minimum of 0.1 seconds.

data.name: Ambush
data.description: +5% trap damage per point against enemies that have not yet triggered one of your traps.

data.name: Tripwire Network
data.description: +1 Fervour per point when a trap is triggered.

data.name: Minefield
data.description: +10% trap arming speed per point. At 6 points: Your traps reserve 5% reduced Fervour.

data.name: Chain Reaction
data.description: When a trap is triggered, the nearest inactive trap within 8 meters is also triggered. At 4 points: This chain can occur once per second.

data.name: Saturation
data.description: +5% evasion chance for each of your active traps, up to 5 traps.

data.name: Scattershot
data.description: When you deploy a trap, there is a 10% chance per point to deploy an additional trap at a random nearby location, which reserves Fervour as normal.

data.name: Overwhelming Presence
data.description: While your Fervour has no room to reserve another trap, you deal 50% more trap damage and trap trigger radius is doubled.

data.name: Hair Trigger Mechanism
data.description: +10% trap damage per point against the first enemy to trigger each trap.

data.name: Reinforced Housing
data.description: Traps are not consumed when triggered. Instead each subsequent trigger costs 15 Fervour, reduced by 1 Fervour per point; with too little Fervour, the trap is used up. At 5 points: Each subsequent trigger deals 20% more damage than the last.

data.name: Delayed Fuse
data.description: Your traps have a 1 second additional arming delay but deal +15% damage per point and cannot be accidentally triggered by you or your gadgets during the arming period.

data.name: Marked Territory
data.description: Enemies that trigger a trap are marked for 5 seconds. Marked enemies take +5% increased damage per point from all sources.

data.name: Precision Placement
data.description: You may only have one active trap at a time. That trap gains +10% damage and +25% area of effect for every 4 traps your maximum Fervour could hold. Anything that lowers what your traps reserve, or raises your maximum Fervour, still counts toward it.

data.name: Bigger Traps
data.description: +15% area of effect for traps per point.

data.name: Death Ground
data.description: +3% DoT damage per point applied by traps. At 6 points: Enemies standing in an area where a trap was triggered continue to take DoT damage for 3 seconds.

data.name: The Last Surprise
data.description: When your last active trap is triggered, it deals damage equal to the combined total damage of all traps triggered in the last 10 seconds. This can only occur once every 30 seconds.

data.name: Calculated Chaos
data.description: Your traps can be placed even when your Fervour has no room to reserve them. Each trap placed that way reserves nothing and drains 5 Fervour per second instead. When you reach 0 Fervour, all of those traps are immediately triggered simultaneously.

data.name: Field Engineer
data.description: +12% gadget attack speed per point. At 4 points: Deploying a gadget does not interrupt any action you are currently performing.

data.name: Reinforced Frame
data.description: +8% gadget HP per point. At 5 points: When a gadget is destroyed, gain 10 Fervour.

data.name: Efficient Design
data.description: Each other active gadget reduces the Fervour your gadgets reserve by 1% per point.

data.name: Overcharge
data.description: When a gadget is deployed, it automatically consumes 2 Fervour per point to grant +5% damage and +5% HP per Fervour consumed.

data.name: Support Network
data.description: +3% gadget damage per point for each active trap on the battlefield. At 4 points: Active gadgets increase trap trigger radius by 10%.

data.name: Hot Deploy
data.description: +2% gadget attack speed per point for every 10 Fervour spent in the last 5 seconds.

data.name: Overclock
data.description: When a gadget is deployed, it passively drains 2 Fervour per point over 10 seconds, gaining +5% attack speed for each Fervour drained.

data.name: Volatile Construction
data.description: When a gadget is destroyed, it explodes dealing damage equal to +15% of its maximum HP per point to all enemies within 4 metres.

data.name: Last Stand Protocol
data.description: When a gadget is reduced below 25% HP, it gains +8% attack speed and +8% damage per point for 5 seconds.

data.name: Rapid Deployment
data.description: Reduces the Fervour cost of all automatic gadget empowerment effects by 1 per point. At 6 points: Once every 15 seconds, your next gadget deployment costs no Fervour to empower.

data.name: Forward Operating Base
data.description: When you deploy a gadget, all other active gadgets are pulled to the most recent gadget.

data.name: Steady Power
data.description: Each active gadget drains 1 Fervour per second. Your gadgets gain +4% damage per point for each point of Fervour above 50% of your maximum that you currently have.

data.name: Persistent Systems
data.description: Gadgets above 50% HP regenerate 1.5% of their maximum HP per second per point. At 4 points: Gadgets that survive for 20 seconds gain a permanent +10% damage stack.

data.name: Power Surge
data.description: Your gadgets build a charge over time, gaining one stack every 5 seconds up to a maximum of 5 stacks. At maximum stacks the gadget discharges, dealing 40% of its attack damage to all enemies within its attack range and resetting to 0 stacks.

data.name: Symbiosis
data.description: +2% gadget damage per point for each second a gadget has been continuously active up to a maximum of 20 seconds.

data.name: Redundant Systems
data.description: +5% chance per point that a gadget ignores damage from a hit entirely. At 6 points: When a gadget successfully ignores damage gain 5 Fervour.

data.name: Siege Mode
data.description: Once you have stood still for 3 seconds, your gadgets gain +5% damage and +3% range for each second you have stood still, up to 10 seconds. Moving ends the bonus.

data.name: Combat Engineer
data.description: +8% gadget attack range per point for each active gadget on the battlefield. At 5 points: Gadgets can attack enemies through terrain within their range.

data.name: Coordinated Strike
data.description: Once per second when you hit an enemy your nearest active gadget also attacks that enemy dealing +8% bonus damage per point. At 4 points: This effect triggers for all active gadgets simultaneously.

data.name: Scrap and Rebuild
data.description: When a gadget is destroyed gain 5 Fervour per point and your next gadget move is ready 2 seconds sooner per point.

data.name: Mechanical Familiar
data.description: Your gadgets reserve 15% reduced Fervour. Your gadgets gain +1% bonus damage and +5% bonus HP per 10 Fervour.

data.name: Army of One
data.description: Each active gadget on the battlefield grants you +15% damage, +8% evasion chance, and +15 maximum Fervour. These bonuses update in real time as gadgets are deployed or destroyed.

data.name: First Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

options.name: Baited
options.description: When one of your traps arms, every enemy within 8 metres of it is drawn to it: it goes for the trap instead of whatever it was attacking, for 4 seconds or until the trap goes off.

options.name: Walking Arsenal
options.description: Your gadgets walk after you, staying within 8 metres of you, and keep firing as they move.

options.name: Lightning Rod
options.description: A hit that would strike you has a 3% chance for each trap and gadget you have on the battlefield, up to 30%, to strike the nearest of them within 10 metres of you instead. A trap struck this way goes off.

data.name: Second Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

options.name: Trail of Wire
options.description: Each time you use your movement skill, the last trap you placed is placed again where the movement began, armed at once.

options.name: Scrap Mines
options.description: When one of your gadgets expires or is destroyed, it leaves a trap where it stood. The trap fires that gadget's attack once, at double damage, at the first enemy to come within 3 metres.

options.name: Cat's Cradle
options.description: Each of your traps and gadgets is joined by a wire to every other one within 10 metres. An enemy crossing a wire is pinned for 1 second, no more than once every 4 seconds, and the nearer end answers: a trap goes off, a gadget fires at it.

data.name: Third Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

options.name: Creeping Mines
options.description: Your armed traps creep toward the nearest enemy within 10 metres of them, at 3 metres a second.

options.name: Bolted Together
options.description: A gadget you place within 4 metres of another of yours is bolted onto it: one gadget, with their health added together, that fires all their attacks with 10% more damage for each gadget in it.

options.name: Counterfire
options.description: Each hit you evade is answered by one of your traps or gadgets for every 2 you have on the battlefield, nearest the attacker first: a gadget fires at it, a trap goes off. No more than once a second.

data.name: Final Oath
data.description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one of three oaths.

options.name: Where They Fall
options.description: An enemy killed within 10 metres of one of your traps or gadgets leaves an armed copy of the last trap you placed where it fell. The copy reserves 1 Fervour and lasts 4 seconds.

options.name: Magnum Opus
options.description: The gadget you have had standing longest uses every skill you use, at its own target and with your full damage. When it is gone, the next longest-standing takes its place.

options.name: Crossfire
options.description: Every hit you land is repeated from each of your traps and gadgets within 15 metres of the enemy, up to 15 of them, at 10% of its damage. A trap that repeats a hit does not go off.

data.name: Ghost Step
data.description: +1% movement speed per point. At 5 points: While above 50% maximum Fervour, gain an additional 2% movement speed per point.

data.name: Razor Instincts
data.description: +3% evasion chance per point for 3 seconds after placing a trap or gadget.

data.name: Thin Air
data.description: You cannot be targeted while moving. Taking damage breaks this effect for 2 seconds.

data.name: Durable Modifications
data.description: +3% damage reduction per point (multiplicative). At 4 points: This damage reduction is doubled while above 50% maximum Fervour.

data.name: Pressure Sensitive
data.description: Traps apply a 20% slow per point to triggered enemies for 2 seconds. At 4 points: Enemies slowed by your traps also take +15% increased damage from all trap sources.

data.name: Sprung
data.description: +3% movement speed per point for 3 seconds after one of your traps is triggered.

data.name: Concealed
data.description: The first enemy to trigger each of your traps is stunned for 1 second.

data.name: Hair Wire Expertise
data.description: +8% trap arming speed per point for each unique trap type you have active.

data.name: Bleeding Ground
data.description: +10% chance per point that triggering a trap also applies a bleed stack to the triggering enemy.

data.name: Snap Back
data.description: +4% evasion chance per point while you have at least one active trap on the battlefield.

data.name: Callous Setup
data.description: +5% trap damage per point for every 10% of your evasion chance, up to a maximum of 60%.

data.name: Mobile Armory
data.description: +2% movement speed per point for each active gadget on the battlefield.

data.name: Overcautious
data.description: +4% evasion chance per point while any of your gadgets are under attack.

data.name: Synchronized
data.description: When one of your traps is triggered, the nearest active gadget immediately fires at the triggering enemy. When one of your gadgets is destroyed, the nearest active trap triggers instantly.

data.name: Emergency Protocol
data.description: +5% movement speed and +5% evasion per point for 5 seconds when a gadget is destroyed.

data.name: Calculated Risk
data.description: Your evasion chance is permanently set to 0%. All gadget damage is increased by 3% for every 1% of evasion chance you would have had from all sources.

data.name: Sentry Network
data.description: +2% evasion chance per point while within 15 meters of at least one active gadget.

data.name: Jury Rigged
data.description: Your gadgets cannot be destroyed. Instead, when they would be destroyed they are reduced to 1 HP and gain +100% damage and +100% attack speed until repaired to full HP. Can only trigger once per gadget per deployment.
